citations.title: Emprise Bank Selects Maximum to Power Its Next Generation of Banking Infrastructure - Emprise Bank
excerpts: # Emprise Bank Selects Maximum to Power Its Next Generation of Banking Infrastructure
**WICHITA, Kan., Oct. 15, 2026** — Emprise Bank has announced a design partnership with Maximum, an AI-native banking infrastructure company, to transform its core banking system.

Maximum will deliver the first AI-native operating system purpose-built for traditional banks, providing them with the speed and agility they need to deliver best-in-class customer experiences. This investment will fundamentally alter Emprise’s economics and enable it to scale its customer count by 10 times in the next 24 months while improving efficiency margins.

Emprise believes adding artificial intelligence to infrastructure built for a different era is not enough. Deloitte's Center for Financial Services [describes](https://www.deloitte.com/content/dam/insights/articles/2025/us188386_cfs_bcm-outlook-2026/pdf/DI_2026-banking-captial-markets-outlook.pdf) the ceiling this can create: the capabilities of new technology may be constrained by the foundation beneath it. Maximum is building AI-native infrastructure for banks, designed from the ground up to replace fragmented legacy technology with a unified system for data, operations, intelligence and the next generation of financial products.

“Our highest priority is empowering our customers to thrive, and that starts with the strategic and operational freedom to be able to deliver what’s best for them instead of waiting on someone else’s roadmap,” said Matt Michaelis, chairman and CEO of Emprise Bank. “That’s exactly what we found in Maximum. A partner who shares our focus on customers, partners and employees.”

The partnership will equip Emprise with advanced technology designed to accelerate innovation, streamline operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences while preserving the personalized, relationship-driven approach that defines the bank. At the foundation, core banking functions will remain deterministic, secure and fully auditable, while the operations surrounding them become increasingly intelligent and automated. AI agents will operate within clearly defined permissions and governance frameworks, enabling the bank to move faster, operate more efficiently and introduce new capabilities without compromising security, control or accountability.

Emprise expects to move its first traffic onto the platform by the end of 2026, with broader migration happening in phases, with existing systems continuing to run alongside the new platform throughout the transition. This approach is designed to protect operational continuity and minimize customer disruption.

basis.reasoning: The public customer announcement names Emprise Bank as a design partner and says initial traffic is expected by the end of 2026; the reviewed customer announcement names no second customer, so the evidence does not meet the requirement to name at least two.

citations.title: Maximum · Careers
excerpts: Maximum is building a core banking platform. Not a layer on top of a legacy core: the ledger, product, payments, card and compliance systems a bank actually runs on. You would be involved in many big design decisions from day one. It also means correctness sits with you. You would own a domain service outright: its schema, its API, its workflows, its tests. When a change touches twelve other services, you follow it into all twelve. We use AI coding agents heavily, and directing them is part of the job.
* Own a domain service end to end: schema, gRPC API, workflows, event consumers, tests, and the docs that explain why you built it the way you did.
* Design tables and queries in our schema DSL.
* Write workflows that survive partial failure: replay-safe, idempotent, and resumable from the step that broke.
* Test against real environments in containers. Mocking is a last resort, and we will ask why you needed it.
* Review pull requests from humans and from agents, with the same suspicion for both.
* Turn messy external inputs into a data model that holds: a vendor file spec, a regulation, a feature or integration.
* Several years shipping backend services in a statically typed language. Go preferred; strong experience in Java, C#, Rust or TypeScript is also welcome.
* Real SQL experience: transactions, isolation levels, query plans, indexing, and migrations that run against tables with data already in them.
* You have debugged a distributed system in anger. You know what idempotency, at-least-once delivery and out-of-order messages do to a design.
* A testing habit, and an argument for why you test against real dependencies rather than mocks.
* You can read an unfamiliar spec, ask the two questions that matter, and start building without waiting for perfect requirements.
* You use AI coding agents seriously and know when to throw away what they give you.
* Banking, payments, ledger, card or ACH experience helps. We can teach the domain; we would rather hire for judgment.

To apply, email your resume to [careers@maximum.com?subject=Application%3A%20Senior%20Staff%20Software%20Engineer](mailto:careers@maximum.com?subject=Application%3A%20Senior%20Staff%20Software%20Engineer) with the subject line “Senior Staff Software Engineer”. ## Staff Software Engineer
* Several years shipping backend services in a statically typed language. Go preferred. Strong experience in Java, C#, Rust or TypeScript etc. is also welcome.
* Real SQL experience: transactions, isolation levels, query plans, indexing, and migrations that have to run against tables with data already in them.
* Banking, payments, ledger, card or ACH experience helps. We can teach the domain. We would rather hire for judgment.

To apply, email your resume to [careers@maximum.com?subject=Application%3A%20Staff%20Software%20Engineer](mailto:careers@maximum.com?subject=Application%3A%20Staff%20Software%20Engineer) with the subject line “Staff Software Engineer”. ## Senior Software Engineer
